summary: Applying an empty candelabrum reaches an unported doapply arm. C use_candelabrum reports that it has no candles and, when the inventory contains a candle, adds a source-specific attachment tip. The complete function also owns extinguishing, underwater/cursed refusals, invocation fuel behavior, and lighting.

source.branch: For a CANDELABRUM_OF_INVOCATION with spe<=0 and lamplit false, use_candelabrum prints the no-candles message, scans inventory for Is_candle, optionally prints the apply-candles tip, and returns without a turn-specific RNG call. Other branches snuff a lit candelabrum via end_burn, refuse underwater or cursed/swallowed lighting, adjust age outside invocation position, mark known at invocation, and call begin_burn.
callers: apply.c:doapply(CANDELABRUM_OF_INVOCATION) calls use_candelabrum; js/apply.js:doapply currently includes the type in its named unported arms.
apply.c:use_candle can attach candles to a carried candelabrum; source state written there determines use_candelabrum’s spe and age branches.
dependencies: Is_candle is a consumed object-type predicate for the inventory-tip branch; walk inventory in source order.
timeout.c:end_burn and begin_burn own timer/light state for lit and lighting branches, including consumed outcomes where used.
invocation_pos, On_stairs, Underwater, Blind, and u.uswallow select output, knowledge, and fuel behavior; preserve integer age rounding (age+1)/2 and source message order.
